ExpXml: <Summary><Title>snRNA Orchestrates ATM Activation to Promote Accurate Repair within Transcriptionally Active Chromatin (HiChIP, Hi-C)</Title><Platform instrument_model="Illumina NovaSeq 6000">ILLUMINA</Platform><Statistics total_runs="1" total_spots="322293249" total_bases="96687974700" total_size="28882032801" load_done="true" cluster_name="public"/></Summary><Submitter acc="ERA35071634" center_name="European Bioinformatics Institute" contact_name="European Nucleotide Archive" lab_name="European Nucleotide Archive"/><Experiment acc="ERX15160583" ver="1" status="public" name="snRNA Orchestrates ATM Activation to Promote Accurate Repair within Transcriptionally Active Chromatin (HiChIP, Hi-C)"/><Study acc="ERP182726" name="snRNA Orchestrates ATM Activation to Promote Accurate Repair within Transcriptionally Active Chromatin (HiChIP, Hi-C)"/><Organism taxid="9606" ScientificName="Homo sapiens"/><Sample acc="ERS27118669" name=""/><Instrument ILLUMINA="Illumina NovaSeq 6000"/><Library_descriptor><LIBRARY_NAME>4OHTHiC_p</LIBRARY_NAME><LIBRARY_STRATEGY>Hi-C</LIBRARY_STRATEGY><LIBRARY_SOURCE>GENOMIC</LIBRARY_SOURCE><LIBRARY_SELECTION>PCR</LIBRARY_SELECTION><LIBRARY_LAYOUT><PAIRED/></LIBRARY_LAYOUT><LIBRARY_CONSTRUCTION_PROTOCOL>DIvA cells were treated with IRAK1 inhibitor for 17 hours, following treatment of 300 nM 4OHT for 1 hour. Each sample group was prepared with 1x107 cells and washed twice with PBS. Cells were resuspended in 10 mL PBS and fixed with 1 mL Fixation buffer (11% formaldehyde (methanol free), 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 0.5 mM EGTA, 50 mM HEPES, pH 8.0) at room temperature for 10 minutes. Glycine was added to a final concentration of 200 mM to quench the reaction, and cells were incubated at room temperature for 5 minutes, then washed once with cold PBS. After centrifugation, the pellet was treated with 500 µL pre-chilled Hi-C Lysis Buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 10 mM NaCl, 0.2% NP-40) containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors for 1 hour at 4 °C with rotation. The pellet was washed again with Hi-C Lysis Buffer, and 100 µL of 0.5% SDS was added, then incubated at 62 °C for 10 minutes, followed by the addition of 300 µL ddH2O and 50 µL 20% Triton X-100 to terminate the reaction, further incubated at 37 °C for 15minutes. The sample was then supplemented with 50 µL 10x DpnII Buffer and 4 µL DpnII (R0543M, NEB), mixed thoroughly, and incubated at 37 °C for 16 hours with shaking. Finally, the sample was heated to 62 °C for 10 minutes to inactivate DpnII, allowed to cool to room temperature. Sample was divided into two equal parts. After centrifugation, the pellet from each part was treated with 300 µL Fill-in Master Mix (30 µL of 10x NEBuffer2, 238.5 µL ddH2O, 15 µL of 1 mM Biotin-16-dCTP [NU-809-BIO16-L, Jena Bioscience], 1.5 µL each of 10 mM dATP, dGTP, and dTTP, and 12 µL DNA polymerase I Klenow Fragment [M0210L, NEB]) and incubated at 37 °C for 30 minutes with shaking. The two parts were then combined, and the reaction was terminated by adding 0.5% SDS and 1% Triton X-100, respectively, followed by incubation at 37 °C for 5 minutes. The sample was again divided into two equal parts after centrifugation, and each pellet was added with 1.2 mL Ligation Master Mix (120 µL of 10x NEB T4 DNA Ligase Buffer with 10 mM ATP, 60 µL of 20% Triton X-100, 6 µL of 2% BSA, 40 µL of 30% PEG 6000, 5 µL T4 DNA Ligase [M0202L, NEB], and 969 µL ddH2O). The mixture was incubated at room temperature for 6 hours with shaking. After combining the two parts, centrifugation was performed, and the pellet was treated with 600 µL Sonication Buffer (1% SDS, 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 20 mM EDTA) containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors. The sample was sonicated using a Covaris M220 focused ultrasonicator for 3 minutes. After 4 °C centrifugation at 15,000 rpm for 20 minutes, 50 µL of the supernatant was used for Hi-C analysis, and the remain was reserved for HiChIP. For the HiChIP sample, NETN buffer was added to adjust the SDS concentration below 0.1% while supplementing protease and phosphatase inhibitors. Preparing 40 µL Protein A beads, washing the beads twice with NETN buffer, and adding them to the sample for a 1-hour incubation at 4 °C with rotation. After centrifugation, the supernatant was added 7.5 µg anti-pNBS1 Ser343 (ab109453, Abcam) antibody, then incubated at 4 °C for 12-16 hours. Prepare an additional 60 µL Protein A beads and wash them twice with NETN buffer, then adding them to the sample, and incubate at 4 °C for 2-3 hours. Subsequently, wash the beads four times with ice-cold RIPA Buffer (50 mM HEPES pH 8.0, 1% NP-40, 0.7% sodium deoxycholate, 0.5 M LiCl, 1 mM EDTA) containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors, followed by wash twice with TE buffer. Add 125 µL of Hi-C Elution Buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 5 mM EDTA, 300 mM NaCl, 1% SDS) to both the HiChIP beads and Hi-C sample, Hi-C sample was added with an additional 120 µL TE buffer, mix thoroughly, and incubate at 65 °C with shaking for 6-16 hours. After centrifugation, the supernatant from the HiChIP group was added 110 µL TE buffer. Hi-C and HiChIP samples were treated with 10 µL RNase A (10 mg/mL) and incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes, then added with 8 µL Proteinase K (10 mg/mL) and incubate at 55 °C for 3 hours. Purify the DNA using phenol-chloroform extraction, then dissolve DNA in 16 µL ddH2O and quantify the DNA concentration by Qubit. For subsequent processing, add 100 ng Hi-C sample (diluted to a total volume of 16 µL) and 16 µL HiChIP samples with the following components: 2.5 µL 10x NEBuffer2, 2.5 µL 1 mM dATP, 2.5 µL 1 mM dGTP, and 1.5 µL T4 DNA polymerase (M0203S, NEB). Mix thoroughly and incubate at 12 °C for 2 hours, then add 10 mM EDTA to terminate the reaction. Prepare 5 µL of Streptavidin C1 magnetic beads and wash them once with 500 µL Tween Wash Buffer (5 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 0.5 mM EDTA, 1 M NaCl, 0.05% Tween-20). Add 25 µL sample and 25 µL ddH2O, and incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes. Separate the beads using a magnetic rack and wash beads twice with 400 µL Tween Wash Buffer. Finally, wash once with 100 µL 1x TD Buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 5 mM MgCl2, 10% dimethylformamide). For the HiChIP group beads, add 4 µL of 5x Reaction Buffer, 1 µL Tn5 transposases (13468ES, Yeasen), and 15 µL ddH2O. For the Hi-C group beads, add 10 µL of 5x Reaction Buffer, 1 µL Tn5 transposases (12207ES, Yeasen), and 39 µL ddH2O. Mix thoroughly and incubate at 55 °C for 10 minutes. Separate the beads using a magnetic rack and add 300 µL Strip Buffer (0.15% SDS, 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 50 mM EDTA), then incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes to inactivate Tn5. Wash the beads twice with 400 µL Tween Wash Buffer and once with 500 µL 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0). Beads were separated using a magnetic rack. PCR amplification was performed by preparing the reaction mixture as follows: 3 µL PCR Primer Mix (Yeasen), 1 µL N5 primer, 1 µL N7 primer, 20 µL ddH2O, and 25 µL Phusion HF 2x PCR Master Mix (M0531S, NEB) were added to the beads. For Hi-C samples, the reactions underwent 11 cycles of PCR, while for HiChIP samples, 17 cycles were performed. Following amplification, libraries were purified using 1x Hieff NGS® DNA Selection Beads.</LIBRARY_CONSTRUCTION_PROTOCOL></Library_descriptor><Bioproject>PRJEB101303</Bioproject><Biosample>SAMEA120417983</Biosample>
